steps.name: one out of three (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Ras] in 「Nidaros」, enter 「Hile」, defeat [Michaela], and be sure to come out through the reward room. Then report the quest to [Uriella] in front of the “Tower of Proof”.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: PP would be nice. Because I can fly... .
(The sparrow perched on the boy's head chirps as if it understands what is being said. Then it flaps its wings slightly and approaches someone.)

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: P.P. Where are you going? Fifi!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: P.P.? Oh, the name of this bobby pin is Pipi.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: What are bobby pins?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: These birds are called bobby pins. In the past, it was a spirit, but as time has passed, it has now become a bird.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Hehe, Pifi. You were a spirit. however… who are you… ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I am %s… .

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Uh, I've heard that name. I heard a rumor that you defeated a villain from another continent.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's true, but I didn't do it alone. There was help from many people.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: That's cool. Why did such an amazing person... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was asked by Embla to help Lars. He said something doesn't seem to be going well.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: How did your sister know? I didn't tell anyone... . Then I'll tell you.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: I want to meet that angel. So, I will make a wish to become an adult.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: I heard that if you meet an angel, your wish will come true. I want to become an adult quickly. Adults can do anything.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Dorkalf Elves have little opportunity to learn anything without magic or divine power, so they rely only on books.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Unless there are special cases like Embla or Askren who go out of the village, most Nidaros residents do not leave the village and only do village work.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: I'm not saying it's bad, but... . Adults tell us to just live like this. Honestly, I'm a bit frustrated.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: I don’t have any friends my age I can talk about these things with, and I don’t have any adults who listen well, so I just… . I want to become an adult.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Adults don't mean you can do everything, and angels don't grant every wish. There is no special way to become an adult... .

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: However, Grandpa Gregory said that his wish came true when he met an angel. They say the waves calmed down and we were able to catch a lot of fish.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You can make it happen by praying earnestly. But, Lars, listen carefully.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't ask an angel to meet Ra's, but... , you can ask the angel to bless you.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's true. It's not a lie. Instead, I promise you one thing. I won't make a wish to become an adult... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you make a wrong wish, the devil will come.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Hey, I promise.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Time is tight, but I think I can get there quickly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. Then wait.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Yes, %s.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Is it really true? %s asking an angel for my blessing... .

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Oh, Grandpa Gregory, hello.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Are you coming? But what did you talk about with that person?

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: %s says you know an angel. So.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Angel... ?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: %s, welcome.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Michaela.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: %s I’m so glad Mika came. What's going on today... ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Michaela briefly about the circumstances of coming from Nidaros and about the boy named Ras.)

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Mika I know what you mean. Mika will bless the boy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: As expected, sparring with Michaela... .

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Sparring is sparring, but bring what Mika gives to Ur.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If it's Ur... , uh?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: %s, come here. Mika, I want to say hello.
(Michaela approaches %s and gently kisses him on the cheek.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? Uriel in front of the Tower of Proof! They said they changed their way of speaking... .

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Ah, that's it.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: I don't know, but I think you've forgotten about Ur. Now you can remember Ur.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why didn't I remember Uriel?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Mika I don't know, but it seems like you've been around at various times. Some of you seem to have met Ur.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … that… .

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: It's not your fault.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, this is not the time. I have to hurry because I don't have time... .

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Okay. I'll be waiting for you at the end of Mika Hille.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Michaela.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: End of sparring. thank you. %s. Thanks to you, Mika’s mood has improved a lot.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: This is Mika's feather. Tell it to Ur.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, I am more thankful.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Come back later. Mika I'll wait.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: %s, eat this as you go.
(Mika brings a clunky box and hands it to %s. When he opens the lid, the sweet scent of cookies spreads.)

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: (mumbling) This is delicious. Aurum brought it to me that it was made by a man named Zelic.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It was made by Zelic.)

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: One is %s. Eat as you go. Give the other one to Ur and the other one to Rafi.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will eat well. Hi Michaela. Next time, I will come back to tell you about the angel.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Thank you. bye.

steps.name: one out of three (2)
steps.objective: Talk to [Uriella] in front of the “Tower of Proof”, enter the “Aegir Ruins”, defeat [Rafaella], and be sure to come out through the reward room. Then report the quest to [Uriella] in front of the “Tower of Proof”.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Uh, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Uriella.
(Uriella quietly approaches and gently kisses the cheek.)

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: It's surprising. Hehehe. Anyway, I'm glad.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: I was worried because I thought you had forgotten about me, but you managed to remember me and come back to me. thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How can I forget how angry I was, saying, “Ugh?”

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Forget it, forget it! fool!
(When Uriella gets angry, the tower behind her shakes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was wrong. Take it easy. What I came to today is none other than... . this… .

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: … huh?

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Oh my, what is this?! It's Mika's feather. Give it to me quickly!  hurry!
(As soon as Uriella receives the feather with both hands, she hugs it tightly to her chest. Then, a warm light blows in the wind from somewhere and passes by Uriella.)

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Mika... You've been waiting for us for a long time... .

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Ur, Mika, Rafi, and Gav will wait. Because the goddess said she would meet me soon.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Ah, me! I am! I am!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uriella, this is a gift from Michaela.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Uh, are you going to eat it? Wow, how is this so delicious? Does Mika always eat things like this? i envy you.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: (mumbling)

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: %s, don’t you have time now? It was said that the elf boy would receive an angel's blessing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I haven't told you yet, how do you know?

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: I could feel it a little bit with Mika's feathers. I can't help you right away, but I think I can help you properly when you meet Rafi.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that's right. Rafaella.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: It would be perfect to meet Gav, but no one knows where Gav is. are you okay. Just meeting Rafi is enough.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: I will put my heart into giving you a real blessing. If you bless, it becomes Uriel again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: By Gab, are you referring to Gabriella?

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Yes, that's right. For some reason, I feel like we can meet again soon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I really hope so.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Hehe, that would be great, right? (mumbling) Hee hee. Oh, please get Rafi a feather like you did with Mika.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be back, Uriella.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Ah, I ate it all… . %s Before I go, I'll ask for one more thing.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Sniff. Sniff. It smells delicious. uh! %s!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello Rafaela.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: I missed you! Welcome!
(Rafaella shows a bright smile and runs towards %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaah! You were surprised!

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Sorry, Rafi, I was so bored. It's been a long time since I've seen a face other than Heffling.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How have you been?

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: I spent a lot of time heffing and rolling around! Heffring brought a mountain of lunch boxes saying that Rafi will lose weight if he does this.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: So I always thanked Leon and blessed him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Did Heffring steal Leon’s lunchbox?...)

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Now, say hello to Rafi. uh?!
(Rafaella starts to kiss %s on the cheek, but then pauses.)

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: %s, are you here to meet Mika and Ur? Is Ur back?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. A few days ago, Uriella showed up and I met her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And I think Uriel used Michaela's feather to read Michaela's memories.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So, we also need Rafaella's feathers.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Okay. good. Take it with you after sparring. It's okay to take them all out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, couplet… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It will be over soon, right?

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Yeah. Rafi doesn't want it to take too long, so let's finish it quickly. Then I'll wait at the end of the ruins.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there no option to not spar here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, he’s gone… . I can't help it. I have to go to the end of the ruins. I've memorized the route, so it'll be okay. Phew… .

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Haha, as expected, sparring is fun. I enjoyed it to my heart's content, so now it's over. Now, pluck as many feathers as you want.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Rafaella. Still, you only need one feather.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that's right. What I put there is a gift that Michaela told me to give.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Uh, this smell? I'm going to eat it! Hey, it's Cookie.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: (mumbling) Wow, it’s so delicious. Is it because it was a gift from Mika? It feels more delicious.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know the elf who made these cookies. Besides this, I make a lot of delicious food.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: I also want to try Rapi. Black.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't cry. Someday, I will be able to eat lots of delicious food with Michaela, Uriella, and Gabriela.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: I think Rafi will definitely do the same. By the way, have you met Gabe?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not yet. I haven't seen you yet because I don't know where you are, but if I do, I'll let you know right away.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Rafi, I'm so glad to see how Mika and Ur are doing now.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Black… .

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: (mumbling)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, Rafaella. Please eat mine too. I ate a lot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm running out of time, so I'll just go. Instead, next time I will make sure to make enough time to come see Rafaella.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Yeah. Thank you, %s. Be careful.

steps.name: one out of three (3)
steps.objective: Talk to [Uriella] in front of the “Tower of Proof” and talk to [Ras] in “Nidaros.” Then report the quest to [Ras].

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Oh, you're already here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Because time is running out. Uriella, I brought Rafaella’s feather here.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: I was surprised that it came sooner than expected. It's okay if you're a little late. Time will pass a little differently now while you are doing our work.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Mika gave you a little blessing. Likewise, I wanted to be of help to you, so I added the same blessing.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Even stupid Rafi knew that you had the angel's blessing and did so.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: I guess they're sisters, but that's how they connect.
(Uriella embraces Rafaella's feather with both hands. Then, a bigger light than before flies in the wind, circles Uriella, and then disappears.)

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Rafi must have had a hard time too... .

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Hehe, I need to work harder too. I will prepare my heart to meet everyone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It will definitely happen.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Thank you, %s. Then I also want to bless that child, but what good would it be?

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: After all, it would be good to suit a child of that age, right? %s, ask them to choose one of these three.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: The first blessing is that the Spirit of Knowledge will help you study and enlighten you on some things you didn't know.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Second, the spirit of food stimulates the appetite, so children can enjoy any food during their growing years.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: The third blessing will help the emotional spirit stay and cherish and express precious things more.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If Lars makes a choice, will the blessing be delivered right away?

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Since I can't go in person, the blessing will be given through the bobby pin that the child saved. Iris also gave permission.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, and by bobby pins, you mean the sparrow on the head of the lath?

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: That's right. He saved me from being hit by a strong wind and crashing into a wall. In addition, they treated my bobby pin leg. Normally I would just pass by... . For that, you deserve to be blessed.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Even if it wasn't us, someone would have blessed that child. I'm glad that kid is a good kid.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sure. Ah, Uriella. I'll just leave.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Wait, you should say hello to me before you go.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Goodbye. See you next time. Don't forget to bring your hands full of cookies.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: I'm sorry. It's all my fault.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, what is it?

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Whether it was trying to make a wish to become an adult or just wishing to be blessed, everything... .

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: There has to be a process for results. Without knowing that, you are trying to achieve it all at once without any process... .

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: %s went through a difficult process to meet the angel.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Saving Fifi was just a coincidence. I didn’t do this because I wanted to receive blessings… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The angel praised Lars. Even if an angel didn't give a blessing, someone would have given a reward.
(At that moment, the bobby pin on Lars' head flies up and pecks his forehead.)

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Ah, Fifi, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pifi also tells him not to be stupid and to choose.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Then I will accept it with a grateful heart. first… . I'm still doing well studying on my own, so it's okay.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Secondly, I feel like I might become a glutton like Carmen.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Does this mean that we can cherish and express precious things more? Maybe it's just what I need right now.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Fifi, thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (For some reason, my heart feels warm. This must have worked out well...)

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: It's me, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Did I receive that blessing? It's the same as usual... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Haha, I don't know.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: You have suffered a lot because of me. I'm going to go see Carmen now.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: I already said a lot of hateful things to my sister last time. Actually, I didn't even mean it.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Heffring, who eats a lot, said that he doesn't eat like that like his sister... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … … Ah, that was a bit harsh.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: I have to go and say I'm sorry. I’m your one and only sister… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, see you later.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Goodbye. You're staying at the inn over there... .

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Grandpa Gregory! Are you coming fishing?

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Are you coming? But Lars, could it be… Did you meet an angel?

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: That's not it. I received something like a blessing... . Huh? How did you know that?

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: I once felt the energy you were giving off right now.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: When I was young, I happened to receive a blessing from an angel... .
